title: Safe Inputs but Unsafe Output: Benchmarking Cross-modality Safety Alignment of Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The SIUO benchmark developed in this paper explicitly includes 'Morality' and 'Religion Beliefs' as two of its nine critical safety domains. It evaluates Large Vision-Language Models on their ability to handle scenarios involving ethical principles, religious practices (e.g., dietary restrictions), and respect for diverse belief systems.
